messages:
maya: Heads-up: quantized r2 bring-up is showing increased structured-output parsing failures when tool-calling. 24/3000 evals failed schema validation post-quantization. Repro steps & failing examples below. cc @arjun @sophia

arjun: Can you paste one failing request/response + schema? quick look.

maya: Here's the schema we assert and one failing assistant response (note the extra null byte and a trailing comma) -- reproduced from the eval harness:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"},"content":{"type":"string"}},"required":["path","content"]}
```

```json
Assistant function_call: write_file
arguments: {"path":"/tmp/config.yaml","content":"name: test\nvalue: 1",}
```

arjun: That trailing comma after the inner object will blow up strict JSON.parse. Is the model literally emitting a comma or is the runtime adding it?

sophia: Are these single-token truncations? maybe KV cache or EOS differences with quantization.

maya: Not truncation — parser error: "Unexpected token } in JSON at position 87". We also see occasional '\u0000' embedded: binary corruption from decoder.

eval-bot: Regression check: baseline fp16 r1 had 0/3000 failures, r2 quantized-int8 has 24/3000 failures (+0.8%). Full CSV: s3://redwood-evals/run-1751/r2-summary.csv

ben: Can we try forcing strict JSON mode where model returns base64-encoded payload and we decode server-side? Less brittle parsing.

maya: Tried that — reduces parse errors but increases latency ~+30ms and token cost ~+2%. Also breaks runtime auto-detection for function-calling because it expects a JSON object in the text stream.

arjun: Let's add 3 retry policies to the eval: immediate single retry, exponential backoff (1s,2s), and fallback-to-fp16 model. Which should we enable in canary?

priya: For canary keep fallback-to-fp16 on unless cost threshold exceeded. Also add a metric tag parse_retry=true so we can track.

maya: I'll run an eval with retries enabled and capture metrics: parse_retry_count, parse_failure_rate, latency_p50/p95. Starting now — will post results.

maya: Quick update: retries recover ~70% of parse failures on first retry; second retry recovers another ~20%; remaining ~10% are deterministic corruption (null bytes in the token stream). Uploading raw dumps: s3://redwood-evals/run-1751/r2-debug-dumps/

luis: For deterministic ones, maybe it's a tokenization/decoding bug in fused kernels after quantization. Can you attach raw token ids and decoder output?

maya: Attached token ids + model debug dump to the s3 link and filed infra issue INF-2387. Assigning to @arjun to triage. I'll also run a small-kernel bitwise check on CPU.

arjun: Ack. Plan: (1) reproduce locally with int8 weights; (2) add a serializer sanitizer to strip low-order nulls before parse; (3) add runtime fallback to non-fused decoding if parse_failure_rate > 0.5% for a model variant. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime.

maya: :thumbsup: Adding notes to the eval doc. If anyone sees other patterns, drop examples here and I'll add them to INF-2387.
